profile.headline: Developer
profile.summary:
I design clean, scalable database schemas and architecture blueprints for early‑stage SaaS founders.

Over 20 years of proven experience in building scalable, cross-platform apps and software.

Creator of SWE-bench Verified-style coding tasks to reliably evaluate AI models’ ability to generate correct code patches.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Building Winui3 apps that delight users.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and implemented software solutions for various business needs using C#, .Net Frameworks, MS SQL, SSRS, Crystal Reports, and Angular 9+.

Managed multiple projects simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines. Works well under pressure.

Optimized database queries and stored procedures for improved performance when working with millions of rows of data.

Collaborated with stakeholders to identify requirements. These usually came as legislative laws 
requiring changes to appraisal codes.

Troubleshot issues related to application performance and/or resolve complex issues in interpretation of new laws.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Crystal Reports · C# · .NET · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL · Software Development

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
C#, .Net Frameworks, MS SQL, SSRS, Crystal Reports, Angular 9+, some SSIS, occasionally VB.NET.

Managed multiple projects across multiple teams. High pressure, tight deadlines, happy customers.

Developed and optimized numerous stored procedures, functions, or queries to correctly 
aggregate large amounts of data from TB sized databases.

Collaborated with stakeholders to identify requirements of legislative laws changes.

Troubleshot issues related to application performance, authorization issues, data issues, coding issues, or user training issues.

Interviewed, hired, trained, and mentored new engineers.

Created 90% of the on-boarding documentation. 

Frequently recommended for awards by the QA team as being someone who makes their job easier and works well with them.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead programmer of team of software engineers. Assign projects, coordinate with support for timelines and priorities, mentor/technical lead, interface between programmers and management, ensure projects are completed on schedule and within budget.

Analyze, design, and code functionality including involvement in the development of requirements and functional specifications.
Work with clients on advanced development enhancements and time sensitive critical support issues.

Researched, proposed, and helped introduced adoption of “The Hub” for collaboration and information sharing between engineering departments.

Collaborated with management to create more thorough training opportunities and increased training documentation for new employees.

Configured SharePoint sites by creating Categories and Keywords to allow filtering for faster search results in company knowledge base.

positions.title: Board Member of the Great Lakes Area Show Series - Educational Dressage
positions.description:
Glass-Ed is a USDF Region 2 Group Member Organization (GMO) based in Michigan. Glass-Ed's goal is to promote the art and sport of Dressage to riders of all ages and abilities.

Committee Chair for Classified Ad's, Newsletters, Show Evaluations, and Volunteer committees. And serve on the Website Committee.

company.name: Great Lakes Area Show Series – Educational Dressage

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
Silverlight, CRM, WCFRia, MS SQL, C#, and SSRS.

Built web services for integration with other systems using WCF framework.

Created and optimized T-SQL queries to meet internal customer needs or resolve latency issues.

Debugged existing application to identify and resolve issues quickly.

Acquired Security Clearance and adhered to the protocols required for safety around hazardous 
materials
positions.insights: Skills: Silverlight · API Development · C# · Microsoft CRM · WCF · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Core responsibilities include enhancing and supporting nine web applications, resolving external and internal client issues, creating Report Server reports which allow decision makers to accurately identify problems or opportunities, and creation of new applications or services to enhance the company’s productivity.

positions.title: .Net Developer
positions.description: Primarily responsible for conducting advanced research, identifying service innovations, understanding and analyzing business functions, development of system specifications, and designing and coding applications that scale well under heavy traffic.

positions.title: Associate Programmer
positions.description: Responsible for developing, maintaining, and supporting software for new and existing systems. Also responsible for all aspects of software development such as analyzing business functions along with designing, programming, testing, and documenting programs.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description: Assist with CIS computer lab operations.

positions.title: 1171 Hygiene Equipment Operator
positions.description:
Installation, operation, maintenance and repair of water purification, distribution, and hygiene equipment systems. 

Also conducted water surveys, water reconnaissance, and water quality analysis.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Taught weekly classes on the basics of computer use to senior citizens. Included overall information on computer systems, use of common software programs, how to organize and store files, and account creation and use of social media and email. 
Focused on making users more comfortable with computers in order to allow them to stay in touch with relatives.

Discover and disseminate information on clinics, shows, or educational events located in, or relevant to, Region 2 demographics.

Present information in a well-organized and aesthetically pleasing way.

Present ideas to Regional Director on ways to better serve members through electronic communications.
